title: CPD / CPE Credit Tracker
description: Tracks continuing professional development (CPD) and continuing professional education (CPE) credits for CPA, CLE, HR (SHRM/HRCI), and CME/CEU credentials. User logs completed activities; tool computes credits earned, gap to renewal, ethics minimum status, pace required per week/month, and on-track vs. at-risk status. Zero embedded data — fully user-driven.
data_vintage: User-driven — no embedded reference data. Requirement figures per published 2024 standards (NASBA, ABA, SHRM, HRCI, ACCME, ANCC).

total_required.description: Total credits required for renewal (auto-filled from profession, user-overridable)

mcp_tool_definition.name: track_cpd_cpe_credits
mcp_tool_definition.description: Tracks CPD/CPE credits for CPA, CLE, HR (SHRM/HRCI), and CME/CEU credentials. Computes gap to renewal deadline, ethics minimum status, and pace model. Returns AP2 cpd_credit_record mandate with downstream handoff candidates to AL-03 (Human Capital Engine) and AL-20 (Exam Cost Planner).

profession_key.description: One of: cpa_annual, cpa_triennial, cle_12, cle_15, shrm, hrci, cme_25, cme_50, ceu_nursing

total_required.description: Override total credits required (optional; auto-filled from profession)

total_earned.description: Total credits already earned (optional; can be computed from activities list)
